scale.compute: Voloridge i7i.12xlarge (48 vCPU / 384 GiB) — parallel per-station-year parse

reproducible_subset.note: Numbers below are the Nepal-adjacent subset re-runnable off the booth box (data/parse.log, data/tidy_master.csv). The 498-station / 12,066-station-year figures above are the full High-Mountain-Asia parse.

cleaning.detail: NOAA encodes missing depth as 9999. It is never coerced to 0 mm of rain.
Precip is reported over 1/3/6/12/24-h windows; only valid periods are kept and normalized to a 24-h daily total.
ISD quality flags marking erroneous or suspect values are excluded before any statistics.
Multiple records for one station-day are collapsed to a single daily maximum.

punchline: Two-thirds of station-days are dry and a third of requested station-years don't exist in the archive. The GEV is fit on what survives — the extreme tail, not the noise.

provenance.data_status: observed NOAA ISD; counts from the reproducible Nepal-adjacent parse
